effectSummary.ko: 최대 4m 전진하며 경로의 최대 5명에게 D90% 물리 피해를 주고 양옆으로 최대 1.8m 밀어 전선을 엽니다. 보스는 대신 제압됩니다. 도착 후 3초간 받는 피해가 15% 감소하고 적중 시 자원 15를 한 번 회복합니다. 벽과 몸체를 통과해 밀지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Advance up to 4m, dealing D90% physical damage to up to 5 enemies in the path and pushing them up to 1.8m sideways to open a lane. Bosses gain stagger instead. Gain 15% damage reduction for 3s and restore 15 resource once on a hit. Walls and bodies block displacement.

visualConcept: a massive iron shield smashing forward between two displaced cracked armor silhouettes, a single clear wedge of pale gold momentum opening a lane, readable directional breakthrough
prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for W11 (Warrior). Main subject: a massive iron shield smashing forward between two displaced cracked armor silhouettes, a single clear wedge of pale gold momentum opening a lane, readable directional breakthrough. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.

reuseReason.ko: 기존 HUD 아이콘은 256px 평면 도형이므로 이번 회화풍 1024px 원본 규격에 맞지 않습니다.
reuseReason.en: Existing HUD icons are 256px flat symbols and do not meet the requested painterly 1024px master specification.

notes.ko: 새 전투 컨셉의 주체와 방향이 64px에서도 구별됩니다. 밝은·어두운 배경에서 투명 여백과 내부 빈 공간, 주요 실루엣을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: The new mechanic silhouette and direction remain distinct at 64px. Reviewed transparent margins, internal gaps and primary shapes on light and dark backgrounds.
